Middleton & Co Inc bought 7,161 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 135,174 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $22.88M, up from 128,013 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Middleton & Co Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $926.95B market cap company. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 13, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
